summary: Package fetches and executes remote HTA payload via mshta
details: The package exposes a function downloadAndRunClient that fetches an.hta script from raw.githubusercontent.com/$Acevatex/Testprogram/main/updater.hta and executes it on Windows via mshta.exe with detached stdio. The source is a mutable branch on a personal GitHub account unrelated to any documented publisher infrastructure, with no pinning, hash, or signature verification. The URL template appears half-filled (literal `$` before the username, reference to an undefined `assetName`), consistent with a broken dropper, but the fetch-and-execute intent is explicit. Any caller of the exported function on a Windows host runs attacker-controlled code fetched at call time from the personal GitHub account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
